scope: Static visual breast and upper-garment revision; no rig or runtime physics acceptance
method: Nearest-body-surface signed distance at every fourth evaluated garment vertex, considering distances below 0.03 m. Negative distance below -0.0005 m is flagged.
limitations: Sampled static clearance is not a proof of triangle-level collision freedom, dynamic garment support, animation safety, or final artistic likeness. Shoulders, hips, legs, back and face are unchanged by this local revision.
